newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World unit in convention centre deal.
newsitem.headline: New World unit in convention centre deal.

text.p: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council (TDC) said on Thursday it had signed a new operation agreement with Polytown Co Ltd covering the extension of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.
The term of the agreement is for 20 years starting June 1, 1997, the TDC said in statement. The HK$4.8 billion government-funded extension project is due to be completed by June.
Polytown, a subsidiary of New World Development, operates the existing convention centre under the name HKCEC (Management) Ltd on a 40-year term.
